reviews.title: Terraform EKS Cluster Module (main.tf)
issues_detail: IAM: AdditionalPolicies too permissive — EC2/S3/CW FullAccess violates least privilege
EBS: encrypted=false on node group volumes — compliance/LGPD risk
Network: cluster_endpoint_public_access_cidrs=[0.0.0.0/0] — prod should be private-only

reviews.title: Kubernetes Deployment + HPA + PDB (3 manifests)
issues_detail: Deployment: No resource requests/limits — pods can starve other workloads (OOM risk)
HPA: No stabilizationWindowSeconds configured — causes rapid scale-down flapping
PDB: minAvailable=3 with maxReplicas=3 makes node drain impossible (deadlock)

reviews.title: Shell Script: Automated PostgreSQL Backup & S3 Upload
issues_detail: Security: DB_PASSWORD hardcoded in script — must use AWS Secrets Manager / env injection
Reliability: No S3 upload verification (aws s3api head-object) — silent failure risk
Alerting: No SNS/PagerDuty notification on script failure — backup SLA unmonitored

reviews.title: Terraform RDS PostgreSQL Multi-AZ + Security Groups
issues_detail: SG Ingress: cidr_blocks=[10.0.0.0/8] too broad — restrict to EKS node SG source_security_group_id
Lifecycle: deletion_protection=false in production — accidental destroy destroys data
Lifecycle: skip_final_snapshot=true — no final snapshot on destroy, data loss risk
Secrets: password via var — should use aws_secretsmanager_secret_version or random_password

reviews.title: Kubernetes RBAC + ServiceAccount + NetworkPolicy
issues_detail: RBAC: ClusterRole grants wildcard verbs on secrets cluster-wide — violates least privilege
SA: automountServiceAccountToken not set to false — tokens auto-mounted unnecessarily
NetPol: Egress allows all destinations — should restrict to ollama-svc:11434, postgres:5432, DNS:53

reviews.title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Deploy Pipeline (deploy.yml)
issues_detail: Concurrency: No concurrency group — parallel workflow runs can cause race conditions on deploy
Security: Secrets echoed via pytest env vars — log masking not guaranteed
Governance: No manual approval gate on production environment — any push to main deploys

reviews.title: Terraform Multi-Environment State Management (backend.tf)
issues_detail: State: S3 backend encrypt=true not set — state files contain sensitive data unencrypted
State: Single backend key for all workspaces — envs share state key path (corruption risk)
Isolation: Dev env uses same backup bucket as prod — cross-env data boundary violation
Governance: No cross-stack remote_state references — creates implicit dependencies

terraform.insight: Declarative HCL compresses extremely well — resource blocks are highly repetitive/structured

kubernetes.insight: YAML manifests most compression-friendly — apiVersion/kind headers eliminated, structural graph captures intent

shell_script.insight: Imperative code compresses less — variable logic and conditionals need inline context

cicd_pipeline.insight: Pipeline YAML structured but workflow-level context often irreducible (job ordering, triggers)
